questions.cardText:
[Anthropology] How do Japanese people typically sign a formal document?
A. By using a dark red pen
B. By using a thumbprint
C. By using a seal
Answer: C. Hanko, or a personal seal, serves the same function as a signature in Western countries. Each hanko is unique and can be registered with local authorities or banks to authenticate documents. When multiple seals from different levels of an organization are required on a document, it is also customary to rotate the seal slightly to show respect to one’s superiors, and the highest-ranking individual’s seal would remain upright.
questions.de: Was verwenden Japaner traditionell anstelle einer handschriftlichen Unterschrift, um offizielle Dokumente zu unterzeichnen?
questions.en: What do Japanese people traditionally use in place of a handwritten signature to sign formal documents?

timeline.labelEn: Hanko personal seals come into general use throughout Japanese society as modernization begins
timeline.labelDe: Persönliche Hanko-Stempel setzen sich mit Beginn der Modernisierung in der ganzen japanischen Gesellschaft durch

questions.notes: Japanese seals are called inkan or hanko (Wikipedia). Timeline: general use 'after modernization began in 1870'. The card's bowing-seal custom (ojigi-in) not checked.

questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] Which planet is farthest from the sun?
A. Uranus B. Neptune C. Saturn
Answer: B.
questions.de: Welcher Planet ist seit der Herabstufung Plutos zum Zwergplaneten der am weitesten von der Sonne entfernte?
questions.en: Since Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet, which planet is the farthest from the Sun?

timeline.labelEn: Johann Galle discovers Neptune near the position predicted by Le Verrier
timeline.labelDe: Johann Galle entdeckt den Neptun nahe der von Le Verrier vorhergesagten Position

questions.notes: Before 2006 Pluto counted as the ninth planet (and 1979–1999 was even closer than Neptune), so the open question names the post-Pluto premise.
